messages:
Alisha (People Ops): Hey — during the contractor onboarding this morning we noticed interviewers for 4 new contractor reqs don't have the scorecard template attached. Can someone check? :thinking_face:
Greg (Recruiting Ops): Ugh saw that too. Looks like the bulk-import pipeline set interviewer_role="interviewer_contractor" and our scorecard mapping only handles "interviewer" and "panelist".
Emma (Hiring Manager): Not great — can we manually attach for these interviews? We start tomorrow and need a consistent rubric. :grimacing:
Greg (Recruiting Ops): Manual attach is possible but clunky. I can do it for the 4 reqs now. Also want a safe short-term workaround in case this repeats.
Mike (Engineering): I pulled the webhook audit — the importer emitted this event: ```{"event":"user_upsert","role":"interviewer_contractor","template_id":null}```. The mapping module dropped unknown roles. I can patch it to default to the "interviewer" template but want sign-off.
Jamie (Recruiting Ops): +1 from me. Defaulting unknown interviewer roles to the standard interviewer scorecard is reasonable. We should also add a validation step to the import UI so vendors can't upload unknown role labels.
Alisha (People Ops): Agree on the default. For now Greg — thank you for manual attach. Please paste the req IDs so I can inform the HMs.
Greg (Recruiting Ops): Done. I attached scorecard template id `sc-789` to reqs: R-3245, R-3246, R-3247, R-3248. Left a comment on each candidate timeline. :white_check_mark:
ATS-bot: processed webhook event for R-3246 — status: success (scorecard attached by Greg).
Mike (Engineering): Working on a small patch in the importer mapping (one-line default). Will deploy to staging by EOD and to prod after a smoke test. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/recruiting-import/pull/412 :hammer_and_wrench:
Emma (Hiring Manager): Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turnaround. Can we add a blurb to the interviewer onboarding doc about role labels vendors should use?
Jamie (Recruiting Ops): Yup — I'll update the doc and send a note to vendor-ops. Also adding a small automated alert next time importer sees unknown role values.
Alisha (People Ops): Great. Post-deploy follow-up: Greg/Jamie can you run a 1-week audit on newly onboarded interviewers to confirm templates are applying? I'll add to the recruiting ops checklist. :spiral_calendar:
